name: TC11 - 编辑后审核通过 → 下游流转验证（数据链路完整性）
description: 验证审核通过后图片URL正确传递到下游节点（算法过滤、套图生产等）。关键数据链路：审核确认 → output_json(passedImg) → g_workflow_instance.common_variable → 下游节点input_data。通过DMS查询验证。

context.dmsNote: 下游验证需通过DMS查询workflow_record_log的output_json和下游节点input_data

dmsQueries.note: 以下SQL用于验证下游数据链路，需通过DMS Alibaba CLI执行
dmsQueries.queryOutputJson: SELECT output_json FROM workflow_record_log WHERE material_id = :materialId AND node_name = '人工审核' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
dmsQueries.queryCommonVariable: SELECT common_variable FROM g_workflow_instance WHERE id IN (SELECT workflow_instance_id FROM workflow_record_log WHERE material_id = :materialId) LIMIT 1
dmsQueries.queryDownstreamInput: SELECT input_data FROM workflow_record_log WHERE material_id = :materialId AND node_name IN ('算法过滤', '套图生产') ORDER BY id
dmsQueries.queryMaterialUrl: SELECT url, origin_url FROM material WHERE id = :materialId
